description: This Java source file defines an Android activity 'CollectionDemoActivity' that demonstrates collection navigation using ViewPager and fragments, including an inner adapter class and a fragment class.

classes.name: CollectionDemoActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating collection navigation with ViewPager and fragments.

classes.name: DemoCollectionPagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for providing fragments for each object in the collection.

classes.name: DemoObjectFragment
classes.description: Fragment class representing individual items in the collection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the ViewPager and action bar.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles action bar item selections, particularly the Up button.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns a fragment for a given position in the collection.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the collection (100).

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for a given page.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and returns the view for a fragment, displaying the object number.
